input.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.exam_xfc1f3.ticket_themes (theme STRING, ticket_count INT, example_ticket_id LONG) USING DELTA

INSERT INTO workspace.exam_xfc1f3.ticket_themes
SELECT theme, cnt AS ticket_count, example_id AS example_ticket_id FROM (
  SELECT theme,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt,
         MIN(ticket_id) AS example_id
  FROM (
    SELECT ticket_id,
           CASE
             WHEN lower(subject) LIKE '%bill%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%bill%'
               OR lower(subject) LIKE '%invoice%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%invoice%'
               OR lower(subject) LIKE '%price%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%price%'
               OR lower(subject) LIKE '%refund%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%refund%'
               OR lower(subject) LIKE '%credit%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%credit%'
               OR lower(subject) LIKE '%subscription%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%subscription%'
               THEN 'Billing'
             WHEN lower(subject) LIKE '%login%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%login%'
               OR lower(subject) LIKE '%password%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%password%'
               OR lower(subject) LIKE '%reset%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%reset%'
               OR lower(subject) LIKE '%2fa%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%2fa%'
               OR lower(subject) LIKE '%sms%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%sms%'
               OR lower(subject) LIKE '%account locked%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%account locked%'
               OR lower(subject) LIKE '%sso%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%sso%'
               THEN 'Login and access'
             WHEN lower(subject) LIKE '%parcel%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%parcel%'
               OR lower(subject) LIKE '%delivery%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%delivery%'
               OR lower(subject) LIKE '%shipping%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%shipping%'
               OR lower(subject) LIKE '%tracking%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%tracking%'
               OR lower(subject) LIKE '%order%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%order%'
               THEN 'Shipping and delivery'
             ELSE NULL
           END AS theme
    FROM workspace.exam_xfc1f3.tickets
  ) sub
  WHERE theme IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY theme
) agg
SELECT * FROM workspace.exam_xfc1f3.ticket_themes ORDER BY theme

`Billing` – 5 tickets, example 1
`Login and access` – 4 tickets, example 6
